# Kuailu Technology received the Global Best-Ai Industry Application Pioneer Award from GAIE 2026, the first full view of the AI-based smart office system

- Publication channel: China Daily News Network (central media)
- Release time: 2026-05-15
- Original link: [https://caijing.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202605/15/WS6a06b9eea310942cc49ac6a0.html](https://caijing.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202605/15/WS6a06b9eea310942cc49ac6a0.html]

## Text
Shenzhen, 14 May 2026 - First Day of the Global Artificial Intelligence Terminal and Seventh Shenzhen International Artificial Intelligence Fair (GAIE 2026), Kuailu Technology (hereinafter “Kuailu”) was awarded the Global Best Industry Application Pioneer Award (Global Best Industry Award) by virtue of its mature landing capacity in the corporate-level AI office. The award was presented by the organizing committee of the fair and was intended to recognize enterprises that had achieved significant results in the industrialization and landscape of AI technology.

Kuailu Technology ' s one-stop AI-based smart office system has covered more than 30 core business scenes, such as meetings, sales, manpower, sales, sales, etc., with nearly 1,000 clients in cumulative services manufacturing, trade, education, etc., and over 200 enterprise-level smarts projects. The core concept of the system is “AI original” — that is, to use AI as a bottom-up design logic that integrates intelligence capabilities into every aspect of business processes, rather than serving as an external plugin or support tool.

During the exhibition, Kuailu focused on its AI-based full matrix products, including Kuailu Meeting, Kuailu Cloud, KuailuAI-CRM, etc., and set up new product experiences, summit presentations and product road shows. The Kuailu exhibition space (1F47 Fukuda 1) has been full since its opening and has attracted worldwide exchanges of business representatives, industry experts and study tours.

Discrepancies from plugin to AI: Kuailu

Currently, most enterprises face the real dilemma of “88 per cent already using AI, but only 6 per cent achieve significant profit growth”. Since 2022, Kuailu Technology has used AI as the bottom capability of the system, helping enterprises to get out of the error zone of "Software+AI Plug-in" or "General Model Directly" by means of a two-wheel drive "Data Bottom Consistency + AI Primary Applications".

On the stand, Kuailu AI CRM provides managers with a full chain of decision-making support, from clue to payback, through modules such as data cockpit, smart combat plan, customer insight, automatic quotations, smart daily newspapers, team analysis, and meets firm requirements for data security, investment return (ROI) and business alignment.

Tomorrow: two primary products of AI are officially released, CEO interprets corporate AI trust and landing on site

Kuailu Technology announced that it will hold a 2026 KuailuAI launch on May 15th. Kuailu TechnologyCEO Rowey will deliver the keynote address "Ai, the Next Generation of Smart Offices " , the first systematic presentation of the full technical architecture and commercial value of "Ai " and the official launch of two original items of AI: AI field specialists (the "Professional Answers" for a defined, low-prevalence business scene) and Kuailu Claw (the Enterprise-wide AI prototype office platform to support privatization deployment and full-chain security control).

In the afternoon, Vice-President Kuailu Technology Tanaka will host the “AI Native CRM Industrial Consortation”, which will provide an in-depth analysis of how KuailuAI-CRM can reshape the sales management growth engine with AI original capacity.

Date: 14-16 May 2026

Location: 1F47 exhibition space, Shenzhen Convention Centre

Highlight event: new product experience, 100% winning egg, CEO speech, IA CRM match

Kuailu Technology was established in 2020 to work on a one-stop AI-intellectual office system, with AI-intelligence as an engine for the integration of AI office, AI collaboration, and the full-scope AI conference. The company has established 11 large regional headquarters in Hong Kong, China, Shenzhen and Singapore, serving over 1,000 clients worldwide.
